name: iq-code
description: IQ Code: your Claude Code session with the IQ skin and the waving iQ flag. With routing on, a one-line band shows the model and thinking level in use. The /iq pane holds Home, Routing, Cost, Plan and Settings: measured cost, the prompt cache's countdown and your plan pace. With an IQ key and Personal plan or higher, /iq-route on lets IQ Routing choose each prompt's model and thinking level; your tokens still go straight to Anthropic on your plan. All dollars are API-equivalent.

iq_api_key.title: IQ API key
iq_api_key.description: Your IQ key for routing, which needs Personal ($6/month) or higher. IQ Code shows measured session cost and pace. Apply changes with /reload-plugins or a restart.
